landing.problem_closing: It is not a lack of knowledge. It is emotion taking over your decisions.

landing.f3_desc: Start strict, unlock more flexibility as you prove consistency.

landing.hero_headline:
Strategy Is Not Your Problem.

landing.hero_subheadline: Garda enforces trading rules that protect you from revenge trading, overtrading, and the impulsive decisions that destroy accounts.
landing.why_title: GARDA Was Built Because We Kept Seeing The Same Pattern
landing.why_subtitle: Every Indonesian trader we interviewed had the same story
landing.why_closing: It is not about strategy. It is about not being able to stop. GARDA is built to break this cycle.
landing.vs_title: Trading With Garda vs Without Guardrails
landing.vs_subtitle: Exchanges and Garda are built for different purposes
landing.vs_closing: Exchanges help you trade more. Garda helps you last longer.
landing.problem_subtitle: Three things that destroy trader accounts — and they all come from within
landing.problem_revenge_desc: Loss then immediately open another position without analysis. High emotion, zero logic. This cycle repeats until the account is empty.
landing.problem_over_desc: 10 trades a day, all random entries. No plan, no stop loss. Exchanges encourage you to trade more — that is their business.
landing.problem_emotion_desc: Profit makes you greedy, loss makes you panic, FOMO makes you buy the top. It is not a strategy problem — it is uncontrolled emotion.
landing.preview_subtitle: Garda is already connected to exchanges and ready to use
landing.preview_trade_desc: Pick a pair, choose direction, Garda calculates position size and risk limits automatically.
landing.preview_cooldown_desc: After a trade closes, the system enforces a cooldown before the next trade. Prevents revenge trading.
landing.preview_lock_desc: 3 consecutive losses? Account locked for 12 hours. Rest, review, then continue.
landing.preview_note: Product is live and connected to exchanges.
landing.how_connect_desc: Connect your exchange API key with Read + Trade permissions only. Withdrawal remains disabled.
landing.how_trade_desc: Pick a crypto pair, choose direction (Long/Short), and select RR ratio. Garda calculates position size and risk automatically.
landing.how_protect_desc: Every trade is protected by automatic SL. Cooldown after close prevents revenge trading. Max 3 trades per day.
landing.how_cycle_desc: After cooldown completes, you can trade again. Journal auto-logs every trade for analysis.
landing.how_lock_desc: 3 consecutive losses → account locked 12 hours. This is protection, not punishment. Rest, reflect, then return.
landing.protect_subtitle: Every rule is designed for one goal: helping you survive longer
landing.protect_cooldown_desc: After every trade closes, you must wait before the next trade. Prevents impulsive decisions after loss (or even after profit).
landing.protect_maxtrade_desc: Phase 1 is limited to 3 trades per day. Every trade must be planned. Advance phases → limit increases.
landing.protect_lock_desc: 3 consecutive losses? Account locked. 1R on the same day? Account locked. Forces you to stop and review before continuing.
landing.protect_lock_outcome: → Cannot destroy your account in 1 day
landing.protect_drawdown_desc: Total losses reach 10R? Evaluation mode. Trading paused, reflection required, then resume after review.
landing.protect_drawdown_outcome: → Account will not be wiped in 1 week

landing.social_placeholder: Trader testimonials will be shown here
landing.faq_why_3_a: Most beginner traders overtrade — the more you trade, the higher the chance of loss. The 3-trade limit forces you to plan every entry seriously. Advance phases → limit increases.
landing.faq_why_cool_a: Emotions need time to settle after a trade — both profit and loss. Without a break, traders tend to immediately revenge. 120 minutes in Phase 1 is the minimum time to cool down.
landing.faq_why_lock: Why can the account be locked?
landing.faq_why_lock_a: 3 consecutive losses is a danger signal: something is wrong. The 12-hour lock forces you to stop, review your journal, and return with a clear head — not with emotions that will cause a 4th loss.
landing.faq_why_leverage_a: High leverage is the #1 reason beginner traders lose capital within minutes. 1x means you trade with 100% margin — same as spot, but with futures pricing. Safer, more controlled.
landing.faq_bot_a: No. Garda does not open or close positions automatically. You decide the trade direction. Garda only enforces limits — like automatic SL, cooldown, and trade limits.
landing.faq_safe_a: Yes. Your funds remain on the exchange (Bybit, Binance, OKX, etc.). Garda does not hold your assets. The API key you provide only has Read + Trade permissions — withdrawal is not possible.
landing.faq_withdraw_a: No. It is technically impossible. The API key you connect to Garda must have its Withdraw permission disabled. Even in the event of a security breach, your funds remain safe on the exchange.
landing.faq_how_start_a: Sign up for a Garda account with Google or email. In the dashboard, select your exchange and enter an API key with Read + Trade permission (Withdraw disabled). Once verified, you can start trading immediately.
landing.final_headline:
Strategy Is Not Your Problem.
Discipline Is.
landing.final_subheadline: Garda does not promise profit. Garda helps you stop destroying your account with impulsive decisions.
